rationale: PR #318 proved the response assembler could choose a secondary qualification as direct_answer because fallback selection occurred after response sections were sorted by generated section IDs. This repair preserves the already-governed drafted explanation order for fallback selection while retaining format-driven display sorting.
authority_impact: No new semantic authority is introduced. The assembler still selects only already-approved explanation content; generated IDs no longer influence which approved statement is promoted as the fallback direct answer.
